rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who arrived late, such as at a party or meeting.

example.english: The latecomer only came in after the meeting had started.
example.traditional: 會議開始咗，遲到嘅人先至入嚟。
example.jyutping: wui5 ji5 hoi1 ci2 zo2 ci4 dou3 ge3 jan4 sin1 zi3 jap6 lai4

rows.note: Use this for someone who has only recently arrived or joined a place or group, rather than someone who was late for an event.

example.english: This latecomer is still getting used to the company environment.
example.traditional: 呢位新嚟嘅人仲未熟習公司環境。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 san1 lai4 ge3 jan4 zung6 mei6 suk6 zaap6 gung1 si1 waan4 ging2
